_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoAmmo: Includes all arrows and bolts.\nIt can be ignored, looted or stashed directly to a horse inventory.\nIf item is stashed it will display asterisk symbol in notification.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoAnimations: Enable or disable horse whistle and follow toggle animations.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoAutoLoot: Slain enemies will have their inventory opened automatically (Basic) or specific items looted according to defined rules (Advanced). Gold and lockpicks will always be looted in advanced mode.\nAuto loot works only in mounted combat with maximum range of 100 feet.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoAutoRetaliate: Followers will engage in combat even if player is riding with weapons sheathed and will not break from combat until it completes.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoBKConsolidate: Whether to use Talk/Loot key to perform harvesting if no actors have been found.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoBKInventoryAbsolute: Absolute: Gives instant inventory access regardless of all conditions.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoBKInventoryLocal: Local: Restrict inventory access so it can be opened only when near the horse.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoBKInventoryRemote: Remote: Gives instant inventory access regardless of distance. Remote access can only be used from rideable zones, major cities, shops, player houses, guild houses, castles and inns.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoBKInventoryTravel: Travel: If not near the horse you can hold down inventory key to fast travel to the horse, open inventory and then travel back to initial position. Travel access can only be used from rideable zones, major cities, shops, player houses, guild houses, castles and inns.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoBKKeyDismount: Which key to use to fast dismount.\nUnbind the key by restoring to default.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoBKKeyHarvest: Which key to use to harvest ingredients from a horseback.\nUnbind the key by restoring to default.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoBKKeyInventory: Which key to use for horse inventory access.\nUnbind the key by restoring to default.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoBKKeySpecial: Which key to use to toggle horse follow.\nUnbind the key by restoring to default.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoBKKeyTalk: Which key to use to talk to people or loot dead bodies from a horseback.\nUnbind the key by restoring to default.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoBehaviorCowardly: Cowardly horse will run away from threats. Best paired with faction relations set to Friendly. Behavior changes apply only to player's current horse excluding summoned horses.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoBehaviorFoolhardy: Foolhardy horse will always fight back and deal more damage than usual. Best paired with faction relations set to Neutral. Behavior changes apply only to player's current horse excluding summoned horses.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoBonusHealth: Increase health of player's current horse. Does not apply to summoned horses.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoBonusSpeed: Increase movement speed of player's current horse and all followers' horses. Also applies to summoned horses.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoBonusStamina: Increase stamina of player's current horse. Does not apply to summoned horses.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoBooks: Includes all books.\nIt can be ignored, looted or stashed directly to a horse inventory.\nIf item is stashed it will display asterisk symbol in notification.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoBooksMinValue: Books cheaper than this value will be ignored.\nBooks that teach skills usually have cost of 50 gold or more.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoCallDist: Followers will use Horse Call if horses are past the certain distance threshold, otherwise followers will normally run toward their horses to mount them.\n1 foot = 21.3 game units or 0.3 meters.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoCameraFix: Enable or disable mounted combat horse camera position auto correction. Camera bug occurs when follower mounts the horse or sheathes the weapon after mounted combat because game does not make difference between player and NPCs both triggering same animation events.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoCombatEscape: Followers will break from combat and mount the horse if player is riding with weapons sheathed.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoConfigPower: Whether to display old configuration power in magic menu. If left hidden it will be automatically shown once game is loaded without MCM capabilities.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoControlModeBK: Bound Key Mode: Use defined keys for each of the following features (Talk/Loot, Harvest, Fast Dismount, Inventory and Follow Toggle). Multi Tap mode will be forced if SKSE not found.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoControlModeMT: Multi Tap Mode: Target horse and press [Activate] button specific number of times (Single Tap - Mount/Dismount, Dismounted Double Tap - Inventory, Dismounted Triple Tap - Follow Toggle, Mounted Multi Tap - Talk/Loot/Harvest).
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoDeferRadius: How far player needs to move away after dismounting before followers decide to dismount themselves.\n1 foot = 21.3 game units or 0.3 meters.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoDeferTime: How long should followers wait for player to leave defer zone before dismounting.\nSet to 0 to wait indefinitely.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoDeferredDismount: If enabled, followers will not dismount until player leaves defer zone or defer time runs out.\nUseful when dismounting to interact with the environment and want followers to stay mounted.\nDoes not work in combat.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoDynamicSpeed: Dynamic speed scales followers' riding speed with distance allowing them to catch up with the player more easily.\nSpeed starts to increase when 1200 game units away from the player with formula:\n(distance-1200)^0.5 resulting in speed percentage (e.g. if distance=3700 then followers ride 50% faster).
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoEquipment: Includes all armor, clothing, jewelry and weapons.\nIt can be ignored, looted or stashed directly to a horse inventory.\nIf item is stashed it will display asterisk symbol in notification.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoEquipmentEnchOnly: If enabled, only magical equipment will be included.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoEquipmentMinVW: Equipment with value to weight ratio lower than this will be ignored.\nFor example if item has 10 weight and costs 250 gold it will only be included if this value is set to 25 or lower.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoEquipmentSelection: Whether to use global equipment for all followers' horses or set individually by talking to each follower.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoFactionRelationsMode: Friendly (mod default) - Horse will neither attack nor get attacked by anyone who is a member of any known faction.\nNeutral (game default) - Horse becomes a valid target for aggressive actors and might participate in combat.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoFactionRelationsUpdate: Once updated, faction relations are saved with the game.\nFactions relations are automatically queued for an update if supported mod or DLC containing new factions is detected.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoFollowersHorses: Convenient Horses can provide followers with their own horses and control their riding behavior.\nSupported follower mods: Extensible Follower Framework, Ultimate Follower Overhaul and Amazing Follower Tweaks. Maximum 15 horses.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoFood: Includes all meat, food and beverage.\nIt can be ignored, looted or stashed directly to a horse inventory.\nIf item is stashed it will display asterisk symbol in notification.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoFormation: Followers will form a delta formation with the player after using group Horse Call.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoGlobalEquipment: All followers' horses will be equipped with selected item.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoGlobalSkin: All followers' horses will be of selected type.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHCAngleTolerance: Ignore target if angle between horse heading direction and target is greater than this value.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHCDamageBase: Fixed amount of physical damage before other modifiers.\nKnocking targets with horse charge is not considered an assault if total damage is zero.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHCDamagePercent: Physical damage as a percentage of target's maximum health before other modifiers.\nKnocking targets with horse charge is not considered an assault if total damage is zero.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHCElevationAngle: Controls vertical angle of attack.\nIncrease to send targets flying or reduce to make them slide over the ground.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHCForceDissipation: Linear loss of the force over the angle of tolerance. If set to zero, force is at its maximum in all directions.\nIf greater than zero, magnitude of push force, damage, stamina cost and speed penalty is reduced up to this amount depending on the heading angle at the moment of impact.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHCImpactPrecog: Horse charge collision calculations do not run in sync with frame rates but it is possible to precognize the moment of impact and execute hit event prematurely. Decrease if targets are being hit by invisible wall. Increase if hit is never occuring or is being delayed.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHCLoadPreset: Load predefined set of physics simulator parameters.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHCPushForce: Push force is scaled with horse speed.\nBy changing this value you can control the amount of force that is used to push targets away.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHCSFXMode: Switch between available impact sound effects.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHCSlowPercent: How much to reduce horse speed on a per target basis.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHCSlowTime: Simulate recoil by slowing the horse temporarily at the moment of collision.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHCStaminaCost: For each target struck horse loses a percentage of its maximum stamina.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHides: Includes all tanning materials.\nIt can be ignored, looted or stashed directly to a horse inventory.\nIf item is stashed it will display asterisk symbol in notification.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHorseCharge: Enable or disable mounted combat horse charge feature.\nSprinting while in mounted combat will allow horse to knock targets it runs into.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHorseEquipmentMode: Armored horses do not have any additional protection (cosmetic feature) and equipment is automatically transferred when switching to a new horse.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHorseFollow: Enable or disable horses following their owners. Can also be toggled in game with related controls. Does not apply to summoned horses.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHorseFollowDist: Player's horse will try to maintain specific distance when following.\n1 foot = 21.3 game units or 0.3 meters.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHorseFollowMode: Smart follow will cause horses to stop following temporarily if player is sneaking or in certain locations.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHorseProtEssential: Player's current horse is essential and cannot die when its health is depleted.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHorseProtInvulnerable: Player's current horse is invulnerable and does not lose health or stamina, allowing it to sprint indefinitely.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHorseProtOff: Player's current horse is vulnerable and may die.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHorseRecall: Followers' horses will be recalled (teleported out of existence) when not being ridden and followers will always use Horse Call when they want to ride.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoHorseTracking: Enable to prevent horse from being moved on fast travel. This feature also prevents game from keeping track of player's last ridden horse when dismounted which in turn might affect mods that rely on game's horse tracking system. Does not apply to summoned horses.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoIngots: Includes all ore and ingots.\nIt can be ignored, looted or stashed directly to a horse inventory.\nIf item is stashed it will display asterisk symbol in notification.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoIngredients: Includes all alchemical ingredients.\nIt can be ignored, looted or stashed directly to a horse inventory.\nIf item is stashed it will display asterisk symbol in notification.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoInventoryRecovery: If queued for recovery any items stored in horse inventory will be automatically trasnfered to the player when configuration is closed.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoInventoryWeightLimit: Horse inventory storage limit will not prevent from using quick transfer functions or directly stashing items via advanced auto loot. Browsing limited inventory will preserve but not show item ownership.\nSet to 0 for unlimited storage.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoJewels: Includes all jewels.\nIt can be ignored, looted or stashed directly to a horse inventory.\nIf item is stashed it will display asterisk symbol in notification.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoKeys: Includes all keys that are not currently owned.\nIt can be ignored, looted or stashed directly to a horse inventory.\nIf item is stashed it will display asterisk symbol in notification.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoLearnWhistleOverride: Suspends the horse whistle learning quest and grants the horse whistle power.\nDoes not have effect if horse whistle power has already been obtained by completing the quest.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoLight: Includes all carriable light sources.\nIt can be ignored, looted or stashed directly to a horse inventory.\nIf item is stashed it will display asterisk symbol in notification.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoMCdamage: Damage is scaled with player level and takes into account follower's related weapon skills, skill enchants and buffs. You may control the final damage percentage.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoMTCombatOverride: Enable to bypass multi-tap processing while in combat to maximize mount/dismount response time.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoMTDelay: Time to wait before interpreting the number of [Activate] button taps in Multi Tap Mode. Lower number gives faster response time at cost of accuracy. Higher number gives more accuracy at cost of response time.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoMTDismountMode: When should fast dismounting be used instead of a standard dismounting.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoMountedCombat: Allows followers to engage in melee mounted combat. Weapons are auto-provided for the duration.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoPoisons: Includes all poisons.\nIt can be ignored, looted or stashed directly to a horse inventory.\nIf item is stashed it will display asterisk symbol in notification.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoPotions: Includes all beneficial potions.\nIt can be ignored, looted or stashed directly to a horse inventory.\nIf item is stashed it will display asterisk symbol in notification.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoPreferRiding: Followers will ride even if player is not riding. Can also be toggled by talking to any of the followers.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoRecipes: Includes all alchemy recipes that are not currently owned.\nIt can be ignored, looted or stashed directly to a horse inventory.\nIf item is stashed it will display asterisk symbol in notification.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoScreenFade: Screen will fade to black for few seconds to hide teleportation effects when using Horse Call.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoScriptLatency: Measure script latency as you play and display notification every few seconds. Ideally latency should stay around 50 ms and never go above 100 ms. Wrong results caused by menu mode should be ignored.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoScrolls: Includes all magical scrolls.\nIt can be ignored, looted or stashed directly to a horse inventory.\nIf item is stashed it will display asterisk symbol in notification.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoSkinSelection: Whether to use global skin for all followers' horses or set individually by talking to each follower.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoSoulGems: Includes all empty and filled soul gems.\nIt can be ignored, looted or stashed directly to a horse inventory.\nIf item is stashed it will display asterisk symbol in notification.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoSpellTomes: Includes all spell tomes.\nIt can be ignored, looted or stashed directly to a horse inventory.\nIf item is stashed it will display asterisk symbol in notification.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMInfoSpellTomesUnknownOnly: If enabled, only spell tomes that teach unknown spells will be included.
line:menu_translation/convenient-horses:.$CHMCMQuestErrorMsg: Convenient Horses main quest is not running.\n\nIt is recommended that you exit all menus and start it via console (StartQuest CH) before proceeding with configuration.
